name: Zarcone
personality: Cruel bandit chief who enjoys violence and preys on the weak.
story: Zarcone, 29, was raised by bandits and now leads the Gaia Brigade, a notorious bandit gang. He came to Dagsion after hearing about the Heroic Games. He is recruited by negotiation on every route, and KeenGamer notes you can talk his fee down to almost nothing on Theodora's route (Renown 4).

personalSkill.name: Hatchet Man
personalSkill.effect: Hit+10 with an axe equipped. Lv20: Vulgar Conduct (Hit+20 if foe HP <= 50%); Lv35: Vulgar Conduct+ (Hit+20, Atk+3 if foe HP <= 50%).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier (60% Dex but only 30% Str; cheap on Theodora's route). Pocket Tactics: C tier.

recruit.extra: Negotiate; you can talk him down to 10G
why: Lowest Support requirement of any route: 1 here vs Cai 3, Dietrich 3, Leda 2.
recruit.tip: Keep haggling: his fee drops to 10G. He deploys in Ch 6 and 7, then goes to storage.

build.part1Target: Brigand by Ch 7; storage from Ch 8
build.notes: Joins Ch 6 at about Lv 15 and holds the Hammer seat for Ch 6 and 7. Alexandra takes the seat in Ch 8; the refined Hammer +2 waits in storage and passes to Tobias in Ch 10, the Giant's Ring to Simon. No Part II or III build.

guide.summary: The stopgap Hammer for Ch 6 and 7: Dex 60 and Hatchet Man (Hit +10 with axes) land the Hit 60 Hammer on armor. Then storage: the Hammer passes to Tobias in Ch 10 (+1 from Ch 9, +2 from Ch 12). Finish foes at half HP for Vulgar Conduct.
guide.playstyle: Walk behind Theodora and swing after Bonaventure moves beside him. Hammer on armor, Hurl at range 2 on wounded foes; keep him off mages (Res 25).
keys: Recruit him in Ch 6 at Renown 4; haggle his fee down to 10G
No refines before Renown 7: [[item:Hammer]] and Iron Axe stay plain in Ch 6 to 7
Move Bonaventure beside him before every Hammer swing: Hit +10 (30%) from Lv 20
Swing at foes beside Theodora: [[ability:Rein]], foe Avo −3
End of Ch 7: Hammer and Giant's Ring to storage for Tobias and Simon
watch: Weight: Hammer 20 vs Bld + 4 with the Giant's Ring: no double. Iron Axe (Wt 10) when a follow-up matters.
Str: 30 growth. He needs Effective+ hits or half-HP foes to kill.
Res: 25 growth. Mages are not his.
Inventory: Ch 7 is 5/6 (Hammer, Iron Axe, Short Axe, Giant's Ring, Concoction).
Join level: about Lv 15 in Ch 6, ~10 under the core. Give him armor kills.
